cards.beforeAttempt: Keep the same topic. Before speaking, you may use: For this attempt, I am sharing one interest. Then give attention to what you want to share.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What label did you notice?
reflectionQuestions: What label did you notice?
Did protecting that label take attention?
What could you describe more specifically?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Ask a second ordinary question about the meeting. Allow yourself to be heard without first hiding every imperfection.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What were you trying to hide?
reflectionQuestions: What were you trying to hide?
Which phrase gave you useful permission?
What is a respectful small action you are willing to try?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Explain the same update to a colleague who needs one practical fact. Make that useful fact the task.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: Were you sharing or proving?
reflectionQuestions: Were you sharing or proving?
What did your listener actually need?
What happened when the task became smaller?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Tell the same story with lighter supervision. Allow the first ordinary wording that fits your meaning; keep respect and clarity.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What were you supervising?
reflectionQuestions: What were you supervising?
What did you still care about?
Did lighter attention make any difference to the experience?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Before answering the next question, use a believable supportive sentence if useful. Then answer: What is one thing you would like to do next? Do not create an awkward moment on purpose.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What information was hidden inside the criticism?
reflectionQuestions: What information was hidden inside the criticism?
What response would help the next moment?
Which supportive sentence feels believable?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Notice any feeling or urge to hide without making a conclusion about your whole self. Say one more meaningful sentence; the feeling does not need to disappear.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What was the event?
reflectionQuestions: What was the event?
What did the feeling seem to say about you?
Which part is known, and which part remains an interpretation?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Choose a welcome, a curious question or a sincere thank-you. Say it with the meaning you want to express, without grading your whole voice.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What did your voice communicate?
reflectionQuestions: What did your voice communicate?
Which reaction was about unfamiliarity?
What one feature would you like to explore gently?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Answer again, giving attention to one detail you want the listener to understand. Do not keep checking whether the watcher is gone.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What did supervision ask you to do?
reflectionQuestions: What did supervision ask you to do?
What brought attention outward?
Did noticing become another task?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Share one more detail. If a speech thought appears, you may notice it without opening an argument with it, then return to the detail.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: Which thought asked for a response?
reflectionQuestions: Which thought asked for a response?
What response did you usually give?
What happened when you returned to the message?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Hear the same message once more, then respond to the detail about the quiet park. Return to that meaning if attention drifts; no perfect-focus requirement.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What detail helped you return?
reflectionQuestions: What detail helped you return?
Did you pretend or clarify?
What did you discover about the other person?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Listen again for what mattered to the speaker, rather than planning a perfect answer. Give one relevant reply or question. There is no fluency comparison.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: When did rehearsal begin?
reflectionQuestions: When did rehearsal begin?
What became clearer when you listened?
Did you allow a pause before replying?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.purpose: Compare a forecast with an observation
cards.beforeAttempt: Try another short request and describe what actually happened. Include uncertainty and difficulty; do not force the observation to disprove the prediction.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What did you know before speaking?
reflectionQuestions: What did you know before speaking?
What had you only predicted?
What was different, even slightly, from the forecast?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Answer again with one chosen permission: a pause, clarification, ordinary vocabulary or a shorter answer. Keep the underlying communication value.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: Which rule made the task narrow?
reflectionQuestions: Which rule made the task narrow?
What value did you want to keep?
What changed when you allowed another option?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.purpose: Choose an action without obeying every impulse
cards.beforeAttempt: Continue the message with the feeling allowed to be present. If body attention is unhelpful, orient to the room and the meaning instead. No requirement to find an emotion.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What was directly felt?
reflectionQuestions: What was directly felt?
What interpretation arrived?
What could you choose while both were present?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Say one useful next detail or request. A constructive next step and frustration can coexist; you need not manufacture a positive feeling.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What mattered underneath the disappointment?
reflectionQuestions: What mattered underneath the disappointment?
What conclusion became larger than the facts?
What response would support the next day?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Practise one respectful request, such as: I would like a moment to finish this point. Ask about timing if needed and allow the listener a real choice.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What expectation was stated?
reflectionQuestions: What expectation was stated?
What did you assume?
What need could you express respectfully?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.purpose: Stop reviewing when the task is done
cards.beforeAttempt: Try the same process with only the one experiment you chose. Make another short map, then stop the review rather than search for a complete cause.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: Did the observation lead to a choice?
reflectionQuestions: Did the observation lead to a choice?
When did analysis stop adding useful information?
What one pattern is worth exploring?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Start another update from one useful sentence, then add the next piece when it becomes available. A pause or clarification remains allowed.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What did the first sentence need to do?
reflectionQuestions: What did the first sentence need to do?
Did you try to prepare the whole answer?
How did the next sentence emerge?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.purpose: Adapt the structure to the listener
cards.beforeAttempt: Explain it again in manageable meaning pieces. Use only what this listener needs; do not announce or police a rigid formula.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: Where did one idea end?
reflectionQuestions: Where did one idea end?
Which pieces did the listener need?
Did the structure help or crowd the task?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Answer this prepared follow-up: What would change if your plan moved to tomorrow? Allow different wording while keeping the useful meaning.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What preparation was useful?
reflectionQuestions: What preparation was useful?
What became a demand to reproduce?
Could you adapt while keeping your purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Practise a time or space request you would actually use, such as: Let me think for a moment, or: Can I finish this point? No fixed number of seconds.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: Where did the time pressure come from?
reflectionQuestions: Where did the time pressure come from?
What request felt natural?
Could you make the message smaller without abandoning it?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Try one small voluntary variation in the same request. You can keep the support or stop the comparison; removal is not the success condition.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What function did the habit serve?
reflectionQuestions: What function did the habit serve?
What did it cost?
What small alternative are you willing to explore?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.purpose: Preserve the point with flexible wording
cards.beforeAttempt: Express the same intended meaning again with a different plain wording if useful. Preserve the point rather than force one exact sound or agree when you do not mean it.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What was the parcel inside the wording?
reflectionQuestions: What was the parcel inside the wording?
Did a change of words preserve or change it?
What helped you keep the point available?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Clarify only a detail that actually needs clarification, or add the next story detail if meaning was clear. Make one observation and end the review.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: Was meaning unclear?
reflectionQuestions: Was meaning unclear?
What did you feel compelled to repair?
What helped you take the next conversational step?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: After this prepared interruption, return if you want: That reminds me of something else. Use a short bridge such as: Before we move on, I want to finish one point about the plan.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What was your bookmark?
reflectionQuestions: What was your bookmark?
What kind of interruption was it?
Which return phrase preserved your meaning?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Describe it again with that one chosen difference. Save an observation, not a personal grade. Do not add speed, shouting or a cleverness test.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What variable did you change?
reflectionQuestions: What variable did you change?
What did you actually notice?
Can you leave part of the result uncertain?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Answer an equally familiar question with a lighter version only if willing. Compare usefulness and choice; your original support remains available.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What did the support offer?
reflectionQuestions: What did the support offer?
When did it become a requirement?
What amount of support would feel useful today?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Make the message or first action smaller if needed, then share one concrete detail. Notice practical friction without judging the depth of your desire.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What matters beyond sounding good?
reflectionQuestions: What matters beyond sounding good?
Where did the action become difficult?
What is a willing next step?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.purpose: Separate observed reaction from a guess
cards.beforeAttempt: Choose a warmer restatement, a firmer boundary, a written response or an exit for a repeated interruption. Share only as much personal information as you choose.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What did you want the listener to do?
reflectionQuestions: What did you want the listener to do?
How much did you choose to disclose?
Which reaction was observed rather than assumed?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.beforeAttempt: Explain your small speaking map to your future self: the situation, one support or experiment, and how you will review it without turning the week into an exam.
cards.duringAttempt: No coaching, grading or reminder banners while the learner speaks.
cards.afterAttempt: What is in your current travel kit?
reflectionQuestions: What is in your current travel kit?
What would tell you to adjust it?
What is your next real speaking opportunity?
cards.repeatInstruction: Repeat the same communication purpose with this one optional experiment. After a short attempt, save one specific observation; keep useful supports available.

cards.purpose: Explore beginning a short spoken message with comfortable outward airflow.
cards.beforeAttempt: Try a short familiar phrase while allowing outward airflow. Use one of these familiar phrases: I would like some water. The meeting starts tomorrow. Can I ask a question?
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Whether beginning felt held, pressured or easier; whether breath remained comfortable.
reflectionQuestions: Whether beginning felt held, pressured or easier; whether breath remained comfortable.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore a pace below your natural pace with a little gentle stretching and natural expression.
cards.beforeAttempt: Try a little more time and gentle stretch while preserving the meaning. Use one of these familiar phrases: I enjoyed speaking with you. Could we discuss the plan tomorrow? Here is the part that matters to me.
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Pace, effort, expression and whether the message still feels like your own.
reflectionQuestions: Pace, effort, expression and whether the message still feels like your own.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore spaces that help you organise meaning and continue comfortably.
cards.beforeAttempt: Say it with a comfortable space at a chosen boundary. Use one of these familiar phrases: The delivery is late. We can change the schedule. Let me think for a moment. There are two options. I prefer the second.
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Whether you used the space for meaning, recovery or renewed checking.
reflectionQuestions: Whether you used the space for meaning, recovery or renewed checking.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore forming sounds with less unnecessary pressing and gripping.
cards.beforeAttempt: Try a familiar word with gentle contact and an ordinary release. Use one of these familiar phrases: My name is here on the list. Please bring the paper. I would like to make a point.
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Contact pressure and intelligibility, not whether you produced the lightest possible movement.
reflectionQuestions: Contact pressure and intelligibility, not whether you produced the lightest possible movement.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore a gradual comfortable beginning of voicing.
cards.beforeAttempt: Try a short comfortable vowel with a gradual voice start. Use one of these familiar phrases: I have an idea. Are we meeting today? It is good to see you.
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Whether onset felt comfortable and whether you added pressure to achieve it.
reflectionQuestions: Whether onset felt comfortable and whether you added pressure to achieve it.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore continuity between words within meaningful phrases.
cards.beforeAttempt: Listen for connections rather than equal beats. Use one of these familiar phrases: I would like to know more. Thank you for taking the time. Let us look at the next step.
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Connection between words, physical effort and whether the meaning remains clear.
reflectionQuestions: Connection between words, physical effort and whether the meaning remains clear.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore releasing an obvious layer of added physical effort while speaking.
cards.beforeAttempt: Make a small comfortable adjustment. Use one of these familiar phrases: I want to ask about the plan. There are two possibilities. This part became easier over time.
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: One chosen area of effort and whether the adjustment freed or crowded attention.
reflectionQuestions: One chosen area of effort and whether the adjustment freed or crowded attention.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore reducing added struggle during an existing difficult moment and continuing the message.
cards.beforeAttempt: Practise a comfortable contact-to-release transition in an easy word. Use one of these familiar phrases: I would like to explain this. Please give me a moment. The point I wanted to make is this.
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Whether added struggle changed and whether you could preserve the message.
reflectionQuestions: Whether added struggle changed and whether you could preserve the message.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore how emphasis and pitch movement carry meaning.
cards.beforeAttempt: Say it with emphasis that matches the intention. Use one of these familiar phrases: I wanted the blue one. Are you coming with us? That was the part I enjoyed most.
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Meaning, expression, comfort and whether the listener can hear the intended emphasis.
reflectionQuestions: Meaning, expression, comfort and whether the listener can hear the intended emphasis.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.

cards.purpose: Explore a clearly audible voice suited to the listener and setting.
cards.beforeAttempt: Try it for a listener farther away in a quiet room at a comfortable volume. Use one of these familiar phrases: I would like to add something. Here is the update from our team. Can everyone hear the last part?
cards.duringAttempt: No continuous technique prompts. Stop for discomfort; keep ordinary breathing and a short message.
cards.afterAttempt: Audibility, physical effort and whether the ending stays present.
reflectionQuestions: Audibility, physical effort and whether the ending stays present.
Was your message clear enough for its purpose?
cards.repeatInstruction: Choose another short phrase if useful. Keep the smallest comfortable amount; no requirement to improve the second attempt.
